description: Source code for a RESTful web service container implementation, including route dispatching, middleware handling, and error recovery.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: Manages a collection of WebServices, routing, middleware, and error handling for HTTP requests.

methods.name: NewContainer
methods.description: Creates a new Container with default settings.

methods.name: RecoverHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom panic recovery function.

methods.name: ServiceErrorHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom error handling function for service errors.

methods.name: DoNotRecover
methods.description: Configures whether panics are recovered or propagated.

methods.name: EnableContentEncoding
methods.description: Enables or disables response content encoding (GZIP/Deflate).

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a WebService to the container, ensuring no duplicate root paths.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a WebService from the container.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an HTTP request to the appropriate WebService.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, with optional response compression.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Registers a handler for a URL pattern.

methods.name: HandleWithFilter
methods.description: Registers a handler with container filters applied.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Adds a filter function to the container.

methods.name: RegisteredWebServices
methods.description: Returns all WebServices registered in the container.

methods.name: computeAllowedMethods
methods.description: Computes allowed HTTP methods for a request.

methods.name: newBasicRequestResponse
methods.description: Creates basic Request and Response objects from HTTP request/response.
